summary: Two follow-ups from T-0760's nits N1/N2. (1) CI honesty gap (N1): .github/workflows/ci.yml's `db` job runs `npm run fitness:db` with ONLY a bare postgres:16 service, no Flowable — 5 ci/checks/db/*.db.test.ts files gate their live assertions behind requireDbAndFlowable() and have NEVER executed a single assertion in any automated CI run to date (confirmed by reading the workflow before any change). New `db-flowable` job (inserted between `flowable` and `stack`) brings up the same docker-compose postgres+flowable substrate the flowable/stack/kc/deploy-acceptance jobs already use, then re-runs the FULL fitness:db suite (not a hardcoded file list — a whitelist would itself rot the same way this gap did). Deliberately NOT added to deploy-dev.needs yet, matching the deploy-acceptance job's own advisory-first precedent (T-0274 EXACT FLIP-CONDITION) — needs to be proven green on the actual runner first. (2) Seed audit (N2): T-0760's reviewer grepped '~14 other db-tier test files' matching the same pre-T-0605 role_assignment seed shape (proposed_by=actorSlug, no confirmed2_by) T-0760 fixed, unverified. Read all 58 files with role_assignment INSERTs individually (not just grepped) and classified each against the T-0605 canonical predicate (confirmed_by IS NOT NULL AND (confirmed2_by IS NOT NULL OR proposed_by IS NULL)): 44 already honest (proposed_by NULL or column omitted), 6 are DELIBERATE dual-control test fixtures (the semi-confirmed shape IS what's under test, e.g. grants-dao-dual-control.db.test.ts, rights-change-requests-deactivated-approver.db.test.ts's documented seedPendingAssignment), and exactly 7 match the stale pre-T-0605 shape byte-for-byte. Fixed all 7 (proposed_by=NULL, matching the T-0750 эталон). Unlike T-0760's actual bug, these 7 were functionally harmless: all 7 grant 'tenant-owner' consumed ONLY by isGenesisOwnerForTenant (src/db/org.ts), which checks confirmed_by IS NOT NULL only and never references confirmed2_by/proposed_by — confirmed empirically (56/56 tests GREEN before AND after the fix, byte-identical outcome). Fixed anyway because the non-canonical shape is a latent landmine if isGenesisOwnerForTenant is ever tightened to the canonical predicate. Separately flagged (not fixed, out of scope): isGenesisOwnerForTenant itself doesn't enforce T-0605 dual-control at all, a possible genesis-owner privilege-escalation gap if 'tenant-owner' assignments can ever go through the 2-approver proposal workflow in production — needs its own investigation. (3) Unplanned but load-bearing finding: the new db-flowable job's first real run against a live Flowable immediately caught a genuinely FLAKY (0-3/3 failures, non-deterministic across runs) test-fixture bug in ci/checks/db/detel-rollup-to-variables.db.test.ts, silently invisible since T-0575/T-0603 for the same reason as the 5 files in (1). Root cause #1: seedOnCreateBinding left trigger_registry_id at NULL, and getOnCreateBinding (T-0606) resolves NULL against 'earliest-created registry' — but both seeded registries in this test carry a literal created_at=0, so the ORDER BY ties and falls through to `id ASC`, i.e. a coin flip of two random UUIDs decides which registry is 'primary'; when the wrong one wins, the on_create binding never matches and no process starts at all. Root cause #2 (T-0603 embedded-flavor test only): the shared seedOnCreateBinding hardcoded field_mapping={amount:'totalAmount'}, but the embedded registry's rollup field is named 'total' — amount is always undefined, so the gateway always takes the DEFAULT branch. Fixed by making both triggerRegistryId and fieldKey explicit params (mirrors the canonical idiom already used by ci/checks/db/approval-registry-guard.db.test.ts's own seedOnCreateBinding). Both are TEST-FIXTURE bugs — confirmed by reading src/http/records.ts, src/db/derived-fields-dao.ts, src/core/rollup-contract.ts; zero production code touched.
